newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mazda to boost output at Hofu plant -- paper.
newsitem.headline: Mazda to boost output at Hofu plant -- paper.

text.p: Mazda Motor Corp will boost production at one of its plants in Japan, partly to meet increasing demand in Europe, a Japanese business daily said on Tuesday.

The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said the operation rate at Mazda's Hofu plant in western Japan would average 50 percent of capacity during the six months to September 30, 1997 and an average 60 percent during the six months to March 31, 1998.
These figures compare with an average of 40 percent for the last few years.
The increase would be both to meet increasing demand in the European market and to shift some of Mazda's output of small cars from another Japanese plant, the paper said.
Mazda officials were not immediately available to comment on the report.
